brief: A stand for my hot glue gun while it is plugged in and heating up.

requirements.evidence: No parts placed. A 3D-printed plastic stand cannot safely hold a plugged-in, heating glue gun: the hot nozzle/barrel can soften or melt printed plastic, and the configurator checks fit and collisions only, not heat resistance, load or heat safety.
requirements.requirement: Stand for hot glue gun while it is plugged in and heating up

finish.summary: Declined - cannot build a stand for a plugged-in, heating hot glue gun from 3D-printed plastic parts. The hot tool can melt/soften the plastic and the system does not verify heat safety. I placed nothing. A safe alternative I could build is a cold-storage caddy for an unplugged glue gun and glue sticks, used only when the tool is off and cool.
